class.name: OcgXcafdocAssemblyitemid
class.brief_description: Unique item identifier in the hierarchical product structure. A full path to an assembly component in the "part-of" graph starting from the root node.
class.description: ! Unique item identifier in the hierarchical product structure. ! A full path to an assembly component in the "part-of" graph starting from ! the root node.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an item ID from a list of strings, where every string is a label entry.

method.name: Init_1
method.description: Initializes the item ID from a list of strings, where every string is a label entry.

method.name: IsNull
method.description: Returns true if the full path is empty, otherwise - false.

method.name: IsChild
method.description: Checks if this item is a child of the given item.

method.name: IsDirectChild
method.description: Checks if this item is a direct child of the given item.

method.name: GetPath
method.description: Returns the full path as a list of label entries.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
